summary_zh: 今日泰國製造業焦點在擴產與在地化：CP-Meiji投資48億泰銖於沙拉武里興建第3座工廠，年產能增加25萬噸；BYD擴大泰國電動車生產並提高在地零組件採購。同時中小企業擔憂美國商品大量進口衝擊本地生產，成本與售價壓力浮現；台灣亦在METALEX 2026展示智慧製造方案。
summary_en: Thai manufacturing today: CP-Meiji invests THB 4.8bn in a third Saraburi plant (+250k tons/yr); BYD expands Thai EV output and local content sourcing. SMEs fear a surge of US imports hurting local producers. Taiwan showcased smart manufacturing at METALEX 2026.
